name: coding-rubber-duck-agent
description: A local voice-first VS Code coding companion powered by open-source models.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/renderer/renderer.js
scripts.service: env OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct OLLAMA_NUM_CTX=4096 CODEDUCK_TTS=0 local_service/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn local_service.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload
scripts.service:voice: env OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct OLLAMA_NUM_CTX=4096 CODEDUCK_TTS=1 KOKORO_VOICE=af_heart local_service/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn local_service.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload
scripts.service:voice:light: env OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3.2 OLLAMA_NUM_CTX=2048 CODEDUCK_TTS=1 KOKORO_VOICE=af_heart local_service/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn local_service.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload
scripts.service:light: env OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3.2 OLLAMA_NUM_CTX=2048 CODEDUCK_TTS=0 local_service/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn local_service.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload
